borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
site_name: Land At Albert Wharf And Swedish WharfWandsworth Bridge RoadLondonSW6 2TY
description: Non-material amendments to the wording of the description of development to planning permission reference: 2021/03898/FUL dated 27th August 2025 to vary the description of development as set out in the consented Decision Notice to omit references to no. of storeys and replace with building heights. Consented description of development: Demolition of all existing buildings and structures; provision of new buildings ranging from 5 to 17 storeys in height comprising: safeguarded wharf for flexible general industrial / storage or distribution floorspace (use classes B2/B8/E(g)(iii)) for waterborne cargo handling including ancillary office accommodation at ground and mezzanine levels; with residential dwellings (use class C3) and ancillary communal floorspace above; a cafe/restaurant on the upper courtyard (use class E(b)); a new Thames Path with associated lift/stair access; a new jetty; communal and private amenity space and landscaping; vehicular access and servicing facilities; car and cycle parking; plant and all associated ancillary and enabling works. Proposed description of development to read: Demolition of all existing buildings and structures; provision of development to provide new buildings ranging from between 31.920m to 73.390m in height comprising: safeguarded wharf for flexible general industrial / storage or distribution floorspace (use classes B2/B8/E(g)(iii)) for waterborne cargo handling including ancillary office accommodation at ground and mezzanine levels; with residential dwellings (use class C3) and ancillary communal floorspace above; a cafe/restaurant on the upper courtyard (use class E(b)); a new Thames Path with associated lift/stair access; a new jetty; communal and private amenity space and landscaping; vehicular access and servicing facilities; car and cycle parking; plant and all associated ancillary and enabling works.
